message.name: FREEZER.DAMAGE.U2A
message.value: 60 hp

message.name: FREEZER.NAME.U1B
message.value: Snow launcher

message.name: FREEZER.DISTINCT.U1B
message.value: You can shoot 2 times per turn, but damage of each shot decreased by 20 hp. First shot freezes units for 1 turn only.

message.name: FREEZER.DESCR.U1B
message.value: Shoots missiles that freeze units within area of effect. Missile is affected by the wind. You may perform 2 shots per turn. First shot freezes units for 1 turn, and second shot for 2 turns.

message.name: FREEZER.DAMAGE.U1B
message.value: 2 shots for 20 hp each

message.name: FREEZER.NAME.U2B
message.value: Aimed snow launcher

message.name: FREEZER.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Improved crosshair and fixed shot power, damage increased by 10.

message.name: FREEZER.DESCR.U2B
message.value: Shoots missiles that freeze units within area of effect. Missile is affected by the wind. You may perform 2 shots per turn. First shot freezes units for 1 turn, and second shot for 2 turns. Improved crosshair and fixed shot power.

message.name: FREEZER.DAMAGE.U2B
message.value: 2 shots for 30 hp each

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.NAME.U1B
message.value: Freezing gas

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DISTINCT.U1B
message.value: The cloud deals cold damage and slows enemies for 1 turn, but lasts for 5 turns.

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DESCR.U1B
message.value: Gas grenade emits a cloud of freezing gas on explosion, which deals cold damage to all units it covers at the end of a turn. Cloud lasts for 5 turns, and its lifetime can be increased by Freezing duration parameter in thrower's equipment. Frozenness parameter in targets' equipment protects them from taking damage for the corresponding amount of cloud's last turns.

message.name: SPIDER.NAME.U1B
message.value: Frostbite spider

message.name: SPIDER.DISTINCT.U1B
message.value: Spider shoots an ice spike that freezes enemy for 1 turn and deals 25 hp damage. Ice spike cannot be dodged. Ignores bonuses to duration of freeze time in equipment: frozenness and freeze duration stats. No longer poisons enemies.

message.name: SPIDER.DESCR.U1B
message.value: Frostbite spider crawls up to an enemy and stands on it. If the enemy moves out, the spider will detonate immediately, dealing severe damage and releasing ice spike that damages and freezes the target for 1 turn (ignores bonuses to duration of freeze time in equipment). Spider will explode in 6 sec after moving starts, if there's no enemy on its way. If target uses any sort of teleportation, spider can teleport as well.

message.name: SPIDER.DAMAGE.U1B
message.value: 65 hp explosion damage, 25 hp ice spike damage

message.name: HOLY_GRENADE.NAME.U2B
message.value: Polar plague

message.name: HOLY_GRENADE.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Unit can move away after throwing. Shoots ice spikes to enemies in large radius, each dealing 80 hp damage. Enemies caught in explosion are frozen for 3 turns. Explosion damage decreased to 80 hp, greatly decreased explosion radius.

message.name: HOLY_GRENADE.DESCR.U2B
message.value: Very powerful grenade. Explodes only after full stop. Shoots ice spikes to enemies in large radius. Enemies caught in explosion are frozen for 3 turns.

message.name: HOLY_GRENADE.DAMAGE.U2B
message.value: 80 hp explosion damage, 80 hp spike damage

message.name: AIR_BLOCKER.NAME.U1B
message.value: Winter guardian

message.name: AIR_BLOCKER.DISTINCT.U1B
message.value: Extinguishes fire in large radius, freezes damaged enemies for 1 turn. Protects the squad from freezing. Releases ice spike instead of electric orb on destruction, that does not bounce off enemies, but insteaded freezes units for 2 turns.

message.name: AIR_BLOCKER.DESCR.U1B
message.value: Device which can be attached to any surface to damage nearby enemies that stay in the air for too long. Stays for 10 turns, increasing its radius every turn. Doesn't spend a turn. Extinguishes fire in large radius, freezes damaged enemies for 1 turn. Protects squad from freezing in range. Releases ice spike on destruction, that deals damage and freezes the destroyer for 2 turns. Doesn't spend a turn.

message.name: CANNON.NAME.U1
message.value: Hand cannon

message.name: CANNON.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Shooting unit gets an opportunity to run away after the shot, damage increased by 10.

message.name: CANNON.DESCR.U1
message.value: Shoots with the cannon ball which detonates only after full stop. The shot power is not regulated.

message.name: CANNON.DAMAGE.U1
message.value: 100 hp

message.name: CANNON.DISTINCT.U2
message.value: Improved crosshair, damage increased by 15, slows targets for 1 turn.

message.name: CANNON.DESCR.U2
message.value: Shoots with the cannon ball which detonates only after full stop. The shot power is not regulated. Slows damaged units for 1 turn. Improved crosshair.

message.name: CANNON.DAMAGE.U2
message.value: 115 hp

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.NAME.U1
message.value: Cat thrower

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Cats aims first damaged target.

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.DESCR.U1
message.value: Shoots a cat which bounces several times at a random direction. After the bounce carpet aims on the first target hit.

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.DAMAGE.U1
message.value: 50 hp, 2 extra bounces

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.NAME.U2A
message.value: Chaotic cat thrower

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.DISTINCT.U2A
message.value: Cats get additional bounce.

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.DAMAGE.U2A
message.value: 50 hp, 3 extra bounces

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.NAME.U2B
message.value: Burning cat thrower

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Damage depends on fire bonus. Ignites the ground on hit. Damage decreased by 10 hp.

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.DESCR.U2B
message.value: Shoots a cat which bounces several times at a random direction. After the bounce cat aims on the first target hit. Cat ignite the land on impact.

message.name: CARPET_BAZOOKA.DAMAGE.U2B
message.value: 2 bounces, 40 hp, fire damage 30 hp per second

message.name: SOUL_GUN.NAME.U1
message.value: Severe soulgun

message.name: SOUL_GUN.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Increased souls' seeking range. Maximum damage per soul increased by 1 hp.

message.name: SOUL_GUN.DAMAGE.U1
message.value: 16 souls for 4 hp to 9 hp each depending on the shooter's health

message.name: SOUL_GUN.NAME.U2A
message.value: Empathic soulgun

message.name: SOUL_GUN.DISTINCT.U2A
message.value: Increased average soul damage by 1 hp. Ignores dodge, reflection, and damage block. The first target hit by 3 souls will receive additional damage x5 from soul's damage. Allied units (but not the shooter!) are healed instead of getting damaged.

message.name: SOUL_GUN.DAMAGE.U2A
message.value: 16 souls for 5 hp to 10 hp each depending on the shooter's health + additional damage x5 from soul's damage

message.name: SOUL_GUN.HINT.U2A
message.value: Just point towards enemy and shoot. The shot can't be dodged. Allies hit by souls will be healed instead. And if all other units are too far, souls will attack the shooter!

dictionary.message: Releases swarm of hungry spirits towards a target. Ignores dodge, reflection, and damage block. The first target hit by 3 souls will receive additional damage. Spirits pick random ally or enemy unit and rush through the ground to it. Enemies are damaged and allies (but not the shooter!) are healed by spirits, effect increases, if the weapon user is wounded. If a spirit doesn't find a target, it attacks the user!

message.name: SOUL_GUN.NAME.U2B
message.value: Noxious soulgun

message.name: SOUL_GUN.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Depends on poison bonuses. First target hit by 3 souls will receive additional damage x5 from soul's damage and become poisoned for 5 turns. Maximum soul damage decreased by 3 hp.

message.name: SOUL_GUN.DAMAGE.U2B
message.value: 16 souls for 4 hp to 6 hp each depending on the shooter's health + additional damage x5 from soul's damage

message.name: SOUL_GUN.DESCR.U2B
message.value: Releases swarm of hungry spirits towards a target. Spirits pick random ally or enemy unit and rush through the ground to it. Damage of spirits increases, if the weapon user is wounded. If a spirit doesn't find a target, it attacks the user! The first target they hit 3 soul, get extra damage and poison for 5 turns.

message.name: BAT.NAME.U2A
message.value: Soul smasher

message.name: BAT.DISTINCT.U2A
message.value: Knocks out unit's soul, turning them to revived zombie (without abilities) until 6 turns. The effect works only on previously-active fighters (they have already made their turn), otherwise it works like a previous upgrade.

message.name: BAT.DESCR.U2A
message.value: A unit attacked by this weapon, is sent flying with a very high speed, and if they've already made their turn this battle, they become revived zombie (without abilities) for 6 turns. If target unit hits the ground or anouther unit, it destroys a small amount of landmass and takes damage, based on current speed.

message.name: BAT.NAME.U2B
message.value: Skull cracker

message.name: BAT.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Knocks a hat off the unit. The effect works only on previously-active fighters, otherwise it works like a previous upgrade.

message.name: BAT.DESCR.U2B
message.value: A unit attacked by this weapon, is sent flying with a very high speed. If target unit hits the ground or anouther unit, it destroys a small amount of landmass and takes damage, based on current speed. If it hits previously-active fighter (they have already made their turn), knocks their head off. Bosses pick up knocked hats after 3 turns. Picking up hats from late-game bosses curses the units.

message.name: AK_47.NAME.U1B
message.value: Snowball thrower

message.name: AK_47.DISTINCT.U1B
message.value: Additional shot in every burst. Throws snowballs instead of bullets. Snowballs deal 12 hp damage, depend on cold damage, do not pierce through units and do not destroy ground.

message.name: AK_47.DESCR.U1B
message.value: A decent and really cold weapon. It shots with snowball bursts. Snowballs can slightly push frozen units and don't destroy ground. You can move between bursts.

message.name: AK_47.DAMAGE.U1B
message.value: 2 bursts with 5 snowball, each snowball deals 12 hp of damage

message.name: AK_47.NAME.U2B
message.value: AK Morozko

message.name: AK_47.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Shoots ice shards instead of bullets that slow units for 1 turn. Damage of each ice shard increased by 2 hp.

message.name: AK_47.DESCR.U2B
message.value: A decent and really cold weapon. It shots with ice shard bursts. Ice shards can slightly push frozen units and don't destroy ground, and slow down units for 1 turn. You can move between bursts.

message.name: AK_47.DAMAGE.U2B
message.value: 2 bursts with 5 ice shards, each ice shard deals 14 hp of damage

message.name: GRAVITY_GUN.DISTINCT.U3
message.value: Tossed crates and medkits deal 180 hp shock damage on impact, shots damage increased by 10.

message.name: GRAVITY_GUN.DESCR.U3
message.value: You can do 2 shots per turn. In pull mode, first shot attracts various objects inside crosshair zone, and second shot throws it with high velocity. In normal mode, each of shots pushes units in air. If you shoot under your feet, you launch up in air without taking any damage. You can move between shots.

message.name: GRAVITY_GUN.DAMAGE.U3
message.value: 2 shots for 40 hp each, tossed crates and medkits hit for 180 hp

message.name: HARPOON.NAME.U2B
message.value: Harpoon cannon

message.name: HARPOON.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Arrowhead breaks through the ground. Damage on hit is reduced by 15 hp and damage from lugging increased by 2 hp The length of the cable is reduced by 30%.

message.name: HARPOON.DESCR.U2B
message.value: Hooks up and pulls an enemy to the attacker, doing damage by electricity while dragging. Can break through thin ground layer. Improved crosshair. Be careful: you stop draggin unit if hook destroys ground near you!

message.name: HARPOON.DAMAGE.U2B
message.value: 30 hp when hits a target, then 11 shocks for 12 hp each every 0.25s

message.name: GROUNDBREAKER.NAME.U1
message.value: Kaiten predator

message.name: GROUNDBREAKER.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Shards become heavier, so they tend to cluster at the bottom of the pit.

message.name: GROUNDBREAKER.HINT.U1
message.value: Kaiten predator is more predictable than ground breaker, and has the same destructive power. Angle-up/down arrows. Increase the power – SPACE. Consider the strength of the wind!

message.name: EMERGENCY_TELEPORT.NAME.U3B
message.value: Antitrap teleport

message.name: EMERGENCY_TELEPORT.DESCR.U3B
message.value: Instantly transfers unit to a random point at a large range. Doesn't waste a turn. Tries to avoid mines and laser barriers, but only if there is safe space in travel radius. Can be used in the air. If cannot find valid destination point for a reasonable amount of time, unit is teleported to the same place. Causes explosion at initial point, that destroys enemy guarding bots in small radius.

message.name: EMERGENCY_TELEPORT.DISTINCT.U3B
message.value: Causes explosion at initial point, that destroys enemy guarding bots in small radius.

message.name: BOULDER.NAME.U3
message.value: Sky crasher

message.name: BOULDER.DISTINCT.U3
message.value: Boulder falls down from the sky. Causes explosion upon impact and another one after full stop, these explosions deal air-dependent damage. Added 1 turn delay at the start of the battle, and can be used only 2 times per battle.

message.name: BOULDER.DESCR.U3
message.value: A huge boulder that falls down from the sky and tumbles chaotically over the map! Throws units into the air, dealing damage depending on boulder's speed. When the boulder deals damage it blocks random weapon for 1-3 turns. Hitting allies (but not the shooter) deals less damage and doesn't block weapons. Ignores force field.

message.name: BOULDER.DAMAGE.U3
message.value: depends on boulder speed

message.name: BOULDER.HINT.U3
message.value: Very chaotic. You can cause serious damage to enemy, if you surround them with girders.

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.NAME.U1
message.value: Energy 2000

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Victim bounces 2 times after being damaged, taking 20 hp damage after each bounce. Main shot damage decreased by 5 hp.

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DAMAGE.U1
message.value: 70 hp from shot, 20 hp from each bounce, 2 bounces

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DESCR.U1
message.value: Shoots an energy bullet, which damages and pushes unit into the air. Pushed units bounce several times, taking additional damage. Has an improved crosshair.

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.NAME.U2
message.value: Energy 3000

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DISTINCT.U2
message.value: Victim can bounce an additional time, but main shot damage decreased by 5 hp.

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DAMAGE.U2
message.value: 65 hp from shot, 20 hp each bounce, 3 bounces

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.NAME.U3
message.value: Energy 4000

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DISTINCT.U3
message.value: Victim can bounce an additional time, but main shot damage decreased by 5 hp. Yes, again.

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DAMAGE.U3
message.value: 60 hp from shot, 20 hp from each bounce, 4 bounces

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.NAME.U3A
message.value: Dino slayer

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.DISTINCT.U3A
message.value: Ignores 60% of victim's armor, damage increased by 10 hp. Laser beam fluctuations are lowered by 33%. Increased beam length and ground piercing distance, though bullet's damage grows over distance slower.

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.DESCR.U3A
message.value: Powerful heavy rifle capable to pierce several enemies with one shot, but each subsequent target gets lower damage. Ignores 40% of victim's armor. Damage increses with distance travelled.

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.DAMAGE.U3A
message.value: up to 140 hp for the first target

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.NAME.U3B
message.value: Wasp slayer

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.DISTINCT.U3B
message.value: Damage increased by 10 hp. Laser beam fluctuations are lowered by 50%. Increased beam length and ground piercing distance, though bullet's damage grows over distance slower. Reduced damage penalty for each subsequent target by 60%.

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.DESCR.U3B
message.value: Accurate and deadly rifle capable to pierce several enemies with one shot, but each subsequent target gets lower damage. The shot can't be dodged by an enemy! Always deals critical damage when the ability is available! Damage increses with distance travelled.

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.DAMAGE.U3B
message.value: up to 130 hp for the first target

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DISTINCT.U2A
message.value: When activated, damages units with additional poison explosion by 50 hp. Units hit by the explosion lose 3 points of the 'Poisoning' parameter (up to 0) for 8 turns. The radius of the gas cloud has been increased by another 25%.

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DESCR.U2A
message.value: Upon explosion bioshock deals damage and emits a cloud on explosion, which deals poison damage to all units it covers at the end of a turn. Units hit by the explosion lose 3 points of the Poisoning parameter (up to 0) for 8 turns. Cloud lasts for 6 turns, and its lifetime can be increased by Poison duration parameter in thrower's equipment. Poisonong parameter in targets' equipment protects them from taking damage for the corresponding amount of cloud's last turns. Can be activated by pressing SPACE.

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DAMAGE.U2A
message.value: 50 hp explosion damage + 50 hp of poison damage, capped at 75 hp

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: When activated, damages units with additional frost explosion by 50 hp.

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DESCR.U2B
message.value: Upon explosion krioshock deals damage and emits a cloud of freezing gas on explosion, which deals cold damage to all units it covers at the end of a turn. Cloud lasts for 5 turns, and its lifetime can be increased by Freezing duration parameter in thrower's equipment. Frozenness parameter in targets' equipment protects them from taking damage for the corresponding amount of cloud's last turns.

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DAMAGE.U2B
message.value: 50 hp from explosion, 50 hp each turn

message.name: FIREWORK.NAME.U1
message.value: Dragon's breath

message.name: FIREWORK.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Increased drill distance. Improved targeting. Can be used only 2 times per battle.

message.name: FIREWORK.NAME.U2
message.value: Storm fury

message.name: FIREWORK.DISTINCT.U2
message.value: Explosion damage decreased by 15, and depends on shock bonuses. Ignores force field.

message.name: FIREWORK.DAMAGE.U2
message.value: 20 hp from impaling, 35 hp from explosion + fall damage

message.name: PUPPET.NAME.U1
message.value: Anna and Belly

message.name: PUPPET.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: You can throw one more Doll per battle, but their health is reduced to 120 hp

message.name: PUPPET.DESCR.U1
message.value: Doll is thrown as grenade and attaches to enemy it hits. Doll captures most types of healing (doesn't work on healing from most bosses' unique abilities), increasing own health by that many. Captures only half of Rabbits' healing via their carrots. To remove the Doll, victim has to take damage from themself or their allies, decreasing Doll's health. By default, the Doll has 120 hp. If thrown into bosses, the Doll automatically vanishes upon 10 turns, dealing slight damage.

message.name: PUPPET.NAME.U2A
message.value: Cursed Child

message.name: PUPPET.DISTINCT.U2A
message.value: Bites off 10 hp for each allied treatment (except for vampirism and healing theft), not wasting turn. Can kill unit!

message.name: PUPPET.DESCR.U2A
message.value: Child is thrown as grenade and attaches to enemy it hits. Child captures most types of healing (doesn't work on healing from most bosses' unique abilities), increasing own health by that many. Captures only half of Rabbits' healing via their carrots. To remove the Child, victim has to take damage from themself or their allies, decreasing Child's health. By default, the Child has 120 hp. Bites its target each time their ally heals (except heals from vampirism or healing theft). Bites do not spend turns, but can kill units. If thrown into bosses, the Child automatically vanishes upon 10 turns, dealing slight damage.

message.name: PUPPET.DAMAGE.U2A
message.value: 10 hp when hit, 10 hp on destruction, 10 hp for each ally health gain

message.name: PUPPET.NAME.U2B
message.value: Ghostly Mandy

message.name: PUPPET.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Passes through ground, has slight homing on enemies. Greatly decreased lifetime when not attached no unit.

message.name: PUPPET.DESCR.U2B
message.value: Mandy is thrown as grenade, passing through ground and slightly homing to enemies, and attaches to enemy it hits. Mandy captures most types of healing (doesn't work on healing from most bosses' unique abilities), increasing own health by that many. Captures only half of Rabbits' healing via their carrots. To remove Mandy, victim has to take damage from themself or their allies, decreasing Mandy's health. By default, Mandy has 120 hp. If thrown into bosses, Mandy automatically vanishes upon 10 turns, dealing slight damage.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.NAME.U1
message.value: Angry mimic

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Added significant damage on direct hit depending on the number of removed attack points. Added improved scope. A direct hit removes attack points for 4 more turns, and a hit on the ground near a enemy takes 2 more turns.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DESCR.U1
message.value: In direct hit with the fighter reduces their points of attack to 30 (no more than 35 points against AI units) for 17 turns, spends turn. In contact with the ground in a small radius reduces the points of attack to 40 (no more than 25 points agains AI units) for 11 turns, turn doesn't spend. Has increased crosshair.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DAMAGE.U1
message.value: 10 hp, +4 hp for each deducted point for direct hits

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.NAME.U2A
message.value: Fatal mimic

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DISTINCT.U2A
message.value: Additionally blocks most attack bonus gains by the target.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DESCR.U2A
message.value: In direct hit with the fighter reduces their points of attack to 30 (no more than 35 points against AI units) for 21 turns and deals increased damage, spends turn. In contact with the ground in a small radius reduces the points of attack to 40 (no more than 25 points against AI units) for 13 turns, turn doesn't spend. Blocks most attack bonus gains (except for bosses' unique methods of obtaining attack, and only lowers attack gains from Boar's leader ability). Has increased crosshair.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.NAME.U2B
message.value: Inverse mimic

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Decreases armor instead of attack, up to 40 points from direct hit, or up to 50 points for a group of targets. The armor reduction when hitting ground near enemy lasts 2 more turns longer.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DESCR.U2B
message.value: Works in both normal and inverse mode (can be activated by holding SHIFT). In normal mode in direct hit with the fighter reduces their points of armor to 40, and in inverse mode their points of attack to 30 (no more than 35 points against AI units) for 21 turns and deals increased damage, spends turn. In contact with the ground in a small radius reduces in normal bode the points of armor to 50 for 15 points, and in inverse mode the points of attack to 40 (no more than 25 points against AI units) for 13 turns, turn doesn't spend. Has increased crosshair.

message.name: CIRCUS_CANNON.NAME.U1
message.value: Circus cannon mk2

message.name: CIRCUS_CANNON.DESCR.U1
message.value: Launches your fighter over a long distance. When they hit the ground there is a powerful explosion, also dealing minor damage to your fighter. Improved crosshair.

message.name: CIRCUS_CANNON.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Added improved crosshair. Explosion damage increased by 60 hp, damage to your fighter decreased by 10 hp.

message.name: CIRCUS_CANNON.DAMAGE.U1
message.value: 180 hp, 30 hp to your unit

message.name: DISC_LAUNCHER.NAME.U1
message.value: Improved disc launcher

message.name: DISC_LAUNCHER.DESCR.U1
message.value: Shoots sharpened discs that bounce off any surface. The disc explodes either when it hits the enemy, or after 4 bounces. Disk damage increases with every bounce. Improved crosshair with an approximate trajectory after the first bounce.

message.name: DISC_LAUNCHER.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Added improved crosshair. Base damage increased by 30 hp, and damage gain by every bounce increased by 5 hp.

message.name: DISC_LAUNCHER.DAMAGE.U1
message.value: 80 hp + 25 hp for each bounce, up to 4 bounces

message.name: HELICOPTER.NAME.U1A
message.value: Assault helicopter

message.name: HELICOPTER.DESCR.U1A
message.value: It's now possible to attack units or destroy ground without leaving your hideout! Helicopter carries 6 bombs. Press SPACE, to drop them. If you press SPACE after using all of your bombs, helicopter falls and explodes. Picking a weapon crate with helicopter gives it an additional bomb. Helicopter explodes from any explosions nearby or when it's owner takes damage.

dictionary.message: Helicopter carries 2 more bombs. Fuel increased by 50%. Does not gain additional fuel by collecting crates.

message.name: HELICOPTER.NAME.U1B
message.value: Armored helicopter

message.name: HELICOPTER.DESCR.U1B
message.value: It's now possible to attack units or destroy ground without leaving your hideout! Helicopter carries 4 bombs. Press SPACE, to drop them. If you press SPACE after using all of your bombs, helicopter falls and explodes. Picking a weapon crate with helicopter gives it an additional bomb and extra fuel. Helicopter explodes when it's owner takes damage.

dictionary.message: Does not explode when dropping bombs close to an obstacle. Fuel increased by 20%.

message.name: SOUL_GUN.ON_SHIFT.NOTE
message.value: While holding SHIFT, the hungry souls of your chosen allies first.

message.name: VACUUM_GRENADE.NAME.U1
message.value: Antigravity grenade

message.name: VACUUM_GRENADE.DESCR.U1
message.value: Must be used near one of the enemy characters. When the grenade explodes, it creates a black hole that attracts surrounding fighters and objects. fighters affected by the black hole take damage from impact with the ground and also destroy a small area of ground as they fall. The black hole ignores weight and knockback bonuses. After three seconds, the black hole disappears, dealing a small amount of damage.

dictionary.message: Ignores the Weighting and Pushback force bonuses. Increased maximum attraction radius and knockback, added improved aim. Must be used next to one of the enemy characters. When falling, the fighters pierce a small area of the ground, and after being in the centre of the hole, they are no longer attracted. Automatically triggers after some time after throwing, no timer and no SPACE activation.

message.name: CANNON.NAME.U3A
message.value: Portable cannon

message.name: CANNON.DISTINCT.U3A
message.value: Added second shot, can move between shots. Projectile damage reduced by 25, explosion radius also reduced.

message.name: CANNON.DESCR.U3A
message.value: The cannon fires a cannonball that bounces off walls and only explodes when it comes to a complete stop. The cannon has 2 shots, you can move between shots.

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.NAME.U1
message.value: Throwing field

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DESCR.U1
message.value: A device that creates a force field that repels most types of projectiles. Works for 10 turns. Can be activated by pressing SPACE. Cannot be moved by any Flying saucer modification.

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: The field can be thrown over a distance and activated by pressing SPACE. Cannot be moved by any Flying saucer modification.

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.NAME.U2A
message.value: Singular field

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DESCR.U2A
message.value: A device that creates a reverse force field that attracts most types of projectiles. Works for 10 turns. The field's range is displayed when you hover over it. The field can be thrown over a distance and activated by pressing SPACE. Cannot be moved by any Flying saucer modification.

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DISTINCT.U2A
message.value: Instead of repelling projectiles, attracts them. The field's range is displayed when you hover over it.

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.NAME.U2B
message.value: Atlas' Palm

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DESCR.U2B
message.value: A device that creates a strong force field that repels most types of projectiles. Works for 10 turns. The field's range is displayed when you hover over it. Can be activated by pressing SPACE. Cannot be moved by any Flying saucer modification.

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Increased gravitational influence. The field's range is displayed when you hover over it.

message.name: THUNDERBOLT.DISTINCT.U2
message.value: The projectile is immune to wind and force fields. Can be detonated in mid-air by pressing SPACE.

message.name: THUNDERBOLT.DESCR.U2
message.value: Thunderbird launches the lightning, that explodes upon contact with units or ground. Releases additional lightnings upon explosion into enemy units in large radius, which ignore ground and does not do knockback. and destroys all objects (mines, barriers etc) in an area of explosion. Main lightning is not affected by the wind and force field, and can be detonated in mid-air by pressing SPACE. Shooter slightly pushed backwards upon releasing lightning.

message.name: THUNDERBOLT.DAMAGE.U2
message.value: 105 hp from main lightning, 70 hp from additional ones
